Katarina|mid.identity: Magic (or mixed) damage assassin who cleans up fights through resets. Her daggers fall to the ground; picking them up triggers an area strike (passive). Bouncing Blade (Q) throws a dagger that bounces, then lands, Preparation (W) tosses a dagger into the air and speeds her up, Shunpo (E) teleports her to a unit or dagger, and Death Lotus (R) channels a storm of blades around her. Every takedown sharply reduces her cooldowns.
Katarina|mid.playstyle: Clean-up assassin: she enters fights once the enemy CC is used and chains takedowns.
Katarina|mid.early_game: Farm with Q and poke by picking up your daggers near your opponent. Use E on a dagger or minion to trade, then leave. Avoid trades against champions who lock you down or beat you up close (Vladimir, Galio).
Katarina|mid.level_1: Bouncing Blade (Q) first. Farm and poke.
Katarina|mid.level_2: Shunpo (E). Q → E onto the dagger on the ground near your opponent → pick it up: a good trade.
Katarina|mid.level_3: Preparation (W). W → E onto the falling dagger → area strike: your basic combo.
Katarina|mid.level_6: Death Lotus: a channel that destroys everything around you. Combo: Q → E → W → R, and every takedown resets your abilities. Roam to the side lanes after pushing.
power_spikes: Level 6: Death Lotus, kills and roams.
First completed item: burst that kills mages.
Katarina|mid.lane_plan: Farm with Q, poke with your daggers and roam as soon as possible after 6: Katarina is one of the best roamers. The mid role quest (faster recall) makes these trips very profitable. Avoid pushing without vision against junglers who lock you down.
Katarina|mid.trading: Short trade: Q → E onto the dagger → pick it up. All-in: W → E → Q → R. In teamfights: wait for the enemy CC, go in on a low target and chain. Give up on it against CC that interrupts your ultimate.
mistakes: Being the first one into a teamfight.
Casting your ultimate in range of an available CC ability.
Forgetting to pick up your daggers.

matchup_notes.Zed: Dodge his ultimate with E onto a dagger.
matchup_notes.Yasuo: His Wind Wall blocks your thrown daggers, not your ultimate; wait for his E.
matchup_notes.Syndra: Dive when her stun is on cooldown.
matchup_notes.Vladimir: He heals and dodges with his Sanguine Pool: roam rather than fight him.

Katarina|mid.mid_game: Roams, cleaning up skirmishes and objectives.
Katarina|mid.late_game: Go in after the enemy CC, take down a low target and chain your resets.
Katarina|mid.ahead: Roam, hunt the carries and clean up fights.
Katarina|mid.behind: Farm and wait for messy fights to chain takedowns.
Katarina|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to roam, clean up skirmishes and chain resets in teamfights.
Katarina|mid.final_tip: Never go in first: wait for the enemy CC to be used, then chain.
